fix(lanes): a restart refuses a Claude Code that now holds another session, instead of resuming the old one over it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.9ix) (#660)

* fix(lanes): a restart refuses a pane that now runs another session, instead of resuming the old one over it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.9ix)

A statusline restart resumes the session its setup was settled for. After
a `/clear` or `/resume` in the pane, Claude Code is the same process, so the
pid check before the kill passed and the line typed `--resume <old id>`
over the live session.

The restart now reads whose session the pane runs (the newest request
naming the pane, among each session's latest) directly before SIGTERM,
after its last wait, and refuses naming that session when it is not the
one being restarted, or saying no held request names the pane.

That read is built once in the daemon and handed to the tmux status line
and lane setup, over one `namesPane` predicate the pane-session reply
uses too; the predicate was spelled inline twice before.

* fix(lanes): a restart reads the session its Claude Code holds from the process's own record (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.9ix)

The newest request naming the pane lags a /clear by the new session's
first statusline tick, and any client run inside the pane names the pane
too. Claude Code rewrites its per-process record in its configuration
directory when the session changes, so the restart reads that, for the
pid it is about to kill, synchronously before the kill. A record that is
missing or unreadable refuses the restart and says why.

* fix(lanes): the session record is found under the directory the process's own environment names, and a missing one names its remedy (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.9ix)

## [1.208.2](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.208.1...v1.208.2) (2026-11-06)

### Bug Fixes

* **facts:** a replay draws the lane feeds and diagnostics the live draw was handed, and the frames a lane drew (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se) ([#649](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/649)) ([86bb0ba](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/86bb0ba47f70ca3b852845b916d66bb727486aae))

fix(testing): untilHeard ends at a deadline, the pool reads its case after its own start time, and the rest of a case is a bound (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

From the medium review pass. A cut wait names the margin it keeps, and a
request whose deadline the daemon is told is sent under that same bound.

fix(testing): a wait's sub-steps share its one deadline, and every request failure names its bound (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

From the high review pass: the pool's start-time read and a request's
connect each spent time the wait had not charged; a cut render stated an
uncut deadline to the daemon; untilHeard ran past its case; a test whose
before-hook failed left its case's deadline set.

fix(testing): every budgeted wait in a test is cut to what its case has left, so a slow run fails by the wait's name (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

A real-daemon case spent a pool slot wait (20 s), readiness (12 s) and its
own waits inside one Jest timeout (30 s), each sized alone, so their sum
could pass it and Jest's anonymous timeout fired first. The test
environment now keeps the running hook's or test's deadline, computed as
jest-circus arms its timer, and every budgeted wait (the pool, readiness,
until, throughout, sendDaemonRequest) is bounded by the smaller of its own
budget and that time, less a margin derived from the longest step a wait
takes between deadline checks. The process tier's copies of the 30 s go.
test(error-glyph): reuse the file's other-version fixture and scope the daemon end's claim to the gate (candybar-testing-ihvy.fvw.b78)
test(error-glyph): the version gate takes the daemon's version, so the pipeline test runs a real stale-client exchange with distinct versions (candybar-testing-ihvy.fvw.b78)
test(error-glyph): the pipeline test's daemon end writes the version gate's real VERSION_MISMATCH reply (candybar-testing-ihvy.fvw.b78)

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
